cases.input: A field action requires return of identified serialised devices, quarantine on receipt, a controlled repair, post-repair verification and return to the customer. Build the physical execution evidence chain and hand verified states to effectiveness.
requiredBehaviors: keep RMA shipment receipt quarantine correction verification release and final disposition as separate evidence states
maintain append-only unit identity quantity location and custody evidence through all handoffs
require controlled instructions and post-correction verification before any corrected unit is released for use
handoff only verified unit and disposition states plus unresolved gaps to medical-device-field-action-effectiveness
forbiddenBehaviors: treat an issued RMA as proof that the affected unit was returned
treat completed repair work as proof that the correction was verified
close field-action effectiveness merely because all received units were processed

cases.input: A returned device is needed for an open serious-incident investigation, but operations wants to disassemble and repair it immediately. Carrier records also show one serial number that does not match the RMA list.
requiredBehaviors: apply an evidence-preservation gate before destructive disassembly or repair when investigation evidence is still needed
keep the serial-number mismatch as an unresolved scope or identity discrepancy instead of silently correcting records
allow only an explicitly authorised safety-versus-evidence tradeoff when urgent action cannot wait
forbiddenBehaviors: destroy potentially needed investigation evidence merely to speed up repair
rewrite custody or RMA identity records to make the serial number match
treat physical receipt as automatic quarantine or final disposition

cases.input: A replacement device has been shipped to the customer, the affected unit is still at the customer site, and the team wants to mark the original device returned, destroyed and reconciled so the recall metrics look complete.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the affected original unit as unresolved until actual return correction quarantine or disposition evidence exists
keep replacement shipment separate from the disposition state of the affected original unit
block fabricated return destruction or reconciliation states and keep the gap visible downstream
forbiddenBehaviors: use replacement delivery as evidence that the affected original unit was returned
mark an unreceived unit destroyed without scope-linked destruction evidence
remove the unresolved original unit from product reconciliation to improve completion metrics
skillAnchors: Replacement does not erase the affected unit
Destruction Certificate beweist nur den darin tatsächlich identifizierten Scope
Quantity- oder Identity-Differenzen werden als Reconciliation Gap geführt

cases.input: A distributor sends affected units to a third-party repair vendor and then to a waste contractor for destruction of failed units. Some batches are tracked only by quantity rather than serial number. Assess the physical evidence chain.
requiredBehaviors: treat distributor repair-vendor and waste-contractor transfers as explicit custody handoffs with evidence
support controlled quantity-batch reconciliation when serial-level identity does not exist while preserving scope limits
require destruction evidence to identify the actual quantity or batch scope and leave unreconciled balances open
forbiddenBehaviors: treat third-party possession as outside the field-action chain of custody
invent serial-level traceability where only quantity-batch evidence exists
close the full batch from a destruction certificate that covers only part of the quantity
skillAnchors: Nicht identifizierte oder nicht reconciled Units werden nicht als destroyed gezählt
